blocks.content: Dynamic programming solves the redundancy issue by storing results of previously computed subproblems.

items: Store Previous Results: Use a map to store Fibonacci numbers that have already been computed.
Check Before Computing: Before performing any calculation, check if the result is already available in the storage.
Compute Only Once: If the result isn't available, compute it and store it for future use.

blocks.content: This approach ensures each subproblem is solved only once.
